title: GeoSilo
subtitle: Compact geometry with explicit precision.
intro: Store geometries as scaled integer coordinates with delta encoding. GeoSilo provides a GEOSILO column type, direct measurements and bounds, explicit encode/decode functions, and validation for untrusted BLOBs.

reference.name: GEOSILO('EPSG:3857')
reference.description: Typed storage with CRS metadata and automatic scale.

reference.name: geosilo_encode(geom[,scale])
reference.description: Encode GEOMETRY to BLOB with automatic or explicit scale.

reference.name: geosilo_decode(blob)
reference.description: Decode BLOB or GEOSILO to a native GEOMETRY value.

reference.name: geosilo_metadata(blob)
reference.description: Read geometry_type, vertex_type and scale without decoding.

reference.name: ST_Area / ST_Perimeter
reference.description: Measure polygons directly, in the coordinate system’s units.

reference.name: ST_XMin … ST_YMax / ST_NPoints
reference.description: Read bounds and vertex counts without decoding.

reference.name: geosilo_is_valid(blob)
reference.description: TRUE for a well-formed blob; never raises an error.

reference.name: geosilo_validate / try_geosilo_decode
reference.description: Describe the first problem, or decode malformed blobs to NULL.

notes.title: Precision follows the scale
notes.body: Encoding rounds coordinates onto a grid with spacing 1/scale. A scale of 100 keeps hundredths of a coordinate unit. Projected-meter defaults use 100; degrees default to 10⁷. CRS labeling does not transform coordinates.

notes.title: Spatial compatibility
notes.body: Either extension can load first. Native ST_* overloads follow spatial's semantics, including MULTI* geometries and collections: areas subtract holes, polygons have length 0 and empty geometries give NULL. Other ST_* functions decode through the implicit cast.

examples.title: Store a projected polygon
examples.caption: Inserting GEOMETRY automatically encodes it for the typed column.

examples.title: Inspect and measure directly
examples.sql:
SELECT ST_Area(geom) AS area,
       ST_Perimeter(geom) AS perimeter,
       geosilo_metadata(geom) AS metadata
FROM plots;
examples.caption: Area 100; perimeter 40; integer scale 100. These are planar measurements.

examples.title: Set a scale for a BLOB pipeline
examples.caption: Returns true, POINT (1.23 2.35): decoding retains the chosen quantization.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN ST_Area(geom)=100 AND ST_Perimeter(geom)=40 AND (geosilo_metadata(geom)).scale=100 THEN true ELSE error('GeoSilo polygon measurements or scale mismatch') END FROM plots;
SELECT CASE WHEN geosilo_decode(geosilo_encode('POINT(1.234 2.345)'::GEOMETRY,100))::VARCHAR='POINT (1.23 2.35)' THEN true ELSE error('GeoSilo explicit scale mismatch') END;

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT geosilo_is_valid('\x54\xff\xff\xff\x7f'::BLOB) AND geosilo_validate('\x54\xff\xff\xff\x7f'::BLOB) IS NOT NULL AND try_geosilo_decode('\x54\xff'::BLOB) IS NULL AND geosilo_validate(geosilo_encode(ST_Point(1, 2))) IS NULL THEN true ELSE error('GeoSilo validation contract failed') END;
